summary: Frontend-only regression for Poly World 'Growing City' Phase 3 (Roads) + Phase 4 (Material Factory + Trade Tower effect) at 390x844. Full flow reached (menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> Skip -> capital tap 195,420 -> enter-city -> city-screen). ALL 6 review-request items PASS: (1) City Screen reached. (2) ROADS: city-roads flips label 'Roads'->'Done', road-layer mounts full-screen, dragging paints 13 preview strokes (fill rgba(138,123,92,0.7)) that persist as 13 brown road cells (fill #8A7B5C) after tapping Done. (3) FACTORY placement: build-factory -> place-layer mounts, drag shows GREEN ghost (rgba(80,200,110,0.55) confirmed), release places a Material Factory (testid factory-b_* overlay appears + factory icon renders on grid). (4) FACTORY dialog: tapping the placed factory opens factory-dialog with 'Planks Factory' heading, stepper testIDs factory-feed-minus / factory-feed-plus / factory-feed-value are all present, tapping factory-feed-plus bumps value 0->2, and the output line updates to '1 plank next turn (uses 2 of your 12 wood)' as expected for Lesnoi/nature tribe. (5) Citadel (city-citadel) opens citadel-dialog. (6) Exit (city-exit) unmounts city-screen -> back on game map; End Turn action-end-turn pressed 2x advances T1->T3 with NO red-screen crash (runCityFactories path executes cleanly). Only ONE new React 18 warning surfaced during the road stroke commit: 'Cannot update a component (GameProvider) while rendering a different component (CityMap)' — caused by calling parent onDrawRoads/onPlace/onCancelPlace INSIDE the setStroke/setGhost updater functions in CityMap.tsx. Non-crashing but should be moved out of the updater. Also confirmed the pre-existing benign RN Web deprecations (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode) already tracked in iteration_14.

react_native_issues.issue: React 18 warning: 'Cannot update a component (GameProvider) while rendering a different component (CityMap)'. Root cause: commitStroke() calls onDrawRoads?.(prev) INSIDE setStroke((prev) => {...}) and commitGhost() calls onPlace/onCancelPlace INSIDE setGhost((g) => {...}). The parent callback synchronously triggers a store update on GameProvider while React is still committing the child's setState. Fix: read the value from state (or copy it via a ref) BEFORE the state setter, or defer the parent callback with queueMicrotask / setTimeout(0). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CityMap.tsx:100-106 (commitGhost) and :122-127 (commitStroke).
RN Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Already reported in iteration_14. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow() helper.

RN Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Already reported in iteration_14. Reference: /app/frontend/app/city.tsx placeHint/hudTop/toast/bottomWrap, /app/frontend/src/components/CityMap.tsx Image/View pointerEvents="none".
RN Web warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Already reported in iteration_14.

action_items: (Non-blocking, code quality) In /app/frontend/src/components/CityMap.tsx, move the onDrawRoads / onPlace / onCancelPlace calls OUT of the setStroke/setGhost updater functions to silence the React 18 'setState-in-render' warning. Suggested pattern: `const s = stroke; setStroke([]); if (s.length) onDrawRoads?.(s);` (or use a ref + useEffect).
(No fix required) Roads Phase 3 ✅ — drag draws preview strokes and persists as brown diamonds after Done; canPlaceCityRoad correctly filters out the citadel footprint and existing buildings.

(No fix required) Material Factory Phase 4 ✅ — factory is free, ghost is green, placement succeeds, the tribe-specific Planks stepper (Lesnoi) renders correctly and plank-preview math is right (feed=2 -> 1 plank next turn using 2 of 12 wood).
(No fix required) End Turn regression ✅ — runCityFactories doesn't crash across 2 turn advances (T1->T3).
(Pre-existing, non-blocking) Address the 3 RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode) already surfaced in iteration_14.
critical_code_review_comments: CityMap.tsx commitStroke and commitGhost mutate parent state (via onDrawRoads / onPlace) from inside a setState updater — this is the React-18 'setState-in-render' anti-pattern and is producing a runtime console.error every time the user finishes a road stroke or drops a building ghost. Move the parent callback outside the updater.

TRIBE_MATERIAL maps only 4 tribes -> {planks, sand, stone, glass}. The FactoryDialog handles all 4 branches but the tribeless material (fallback) would produce an empty dialog (only the title + Close). Not reachable today but worth a safe default.

The FactoryDialog planks branch uses Math.min(feed, woodHave) - (... % 2) to compute 'usable' wood — this correctly displays partial production when the player is short on wood, matching engine.runCityFactories. Nice consistency between UI and engine.

rca_of_issue: No user-visible bug found this iteration. Only a code-quality warning: CityMap.commitStroke and commitGhost invoke parent callbacks (onDrawRoads / onPlace / onCancelPlace) from inside the setStroke/setGhost updater lambda, which triggers React 18's 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' warning against GameProvider. Fix: capture the previous value first, call the setter with the reset value, THEN invoke the parent callback outside the updater.
